environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed as part of a Step Functions workflow. The Lambda is fronted by API Gateway (REST API, no authorization) for manual retry/trigger capability. Deployed in EKS namespace 'workflow-processing' with an Envoy sidecar proxy. No request filtering or rate limiting on the API Gateway endpoint. The function returns distinct error messages for padding errors vs other decryption failures, enabling a classic padding oracle attack over repeated HTTP requests.

config.api_gateway: REST API, no authorizer, no WAF
config.service_mesh: Istio 1.19 installed, no restrictive policies applied
